name: @comprehendo/cli
description: Comprehendo consumer CLI: the one place in this monorepo allowed to touch the network (CC6 No Telemetry [27] scans packages/core, packages/python and packages/registry-tools for zero network code; this package exists outside that boundary on purpose, for the one verb that genuinely needs to reach the npm registry on the consumer's own explicit request). `comprehendo add <pkg>` checks whether a corpus is published and installs it; every other verb (`init`/`scan`/`diff`/`pack`) delegates to @comprehendo/core's own network-free implementation unchanged. Internal, unpublished workspace package; the root comprehendo npm package's `bin` re-exports this package's build unchanged, the same pattern the root's `index.js` already uses for @comprehendo/core.

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build --prefix ../core && npm run build --prefix ../registry-tools

author: TheDecipherist
